Expert Chat

Integration API for creating custom chat experiences with Alpha Knowledge experts.

Overview

The Chat Completion API allows you to integrate Alpha Knowledge experts into your applications. After creating an expert and uploading knowledge in the portal, you can use this API to build custom chat interfaces.

API Reference

Chat Completion

Creates a chat completion for the given conversation messages.

POST /experts/{expert_id}/v2/chat/completions

ParameterDescription
expert_idThe ID of your expert (found in the portal)
Request Body
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "When can I play billiards?"
    }
  ],
  "user": "user@example.com",
  "stream": false,
  "tags": ["tag1", "tag2"],
  "tagFilterMode": "alt",
  "folderIds": [1, 2, 3]
}
FieldTypeRequiredDescription
messagesarrayYesList of messages comprising the conversation so far
userstringYesUnique identifier for the end-user (for auditing purposes)
streambooleanNoWhether to stream the response (default: false)
tagsarray[string]NoKnowledge tags to filter against (default: include all knowledges)
tagFilterModestringNoTag matching mode: "alt" (match any tag) or "all" (match all); default: "alt"
folderIdsarray[number]NoKnowledges folder IDs to filter (default: include all knowledges)
Response
{
  "choices": [
    {
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "You can play billiards during the following timings: 
- 12:30 PM to 2:00 PM 
- 7:00 PM onwards 

Your invited guests are also required to follow these timings if they are playing games. [1]"
      },
      "index": 0,
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    },
    {
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "{\"content\":\"\",\"citations\":[{\"id\":123,\"source\":\"https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bgtKiE2v0CLtHPWUeyQjjQ1DymZI6Bho/view\",\"title\":\"Office Guideline\"}],\"disclaimer\":\"\", \"images\":[{\"id\":8550,\"source\":\"https://knowledge.alpha.insea.io/webapi/public/images/0dc60f2ce4580fd1443dcb8465432d0a\",\"content_type\":\"image/png\",\"name\":\"0dc60f2ce4580fd1443dcb8465432d0a\"}]}"
      },
      "index": 1,
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ],
  "created": 1733116035,
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 2468,
    "completion_tokens": 51,
    "total_tokens": 2519
  }
}
Response Structure
FieldDescription
choicesArray of completion choices (contains both content and metadata)
createdUnix timestamp of when the completion was created
modelModel used for completion
usageToken usage statistics

The response contains two elements in the choices array:

  1. The first element (index 0) contains the actual response content
  2. The second element (index 1) contains metadata in JSON format
Metadata Structure

The metadata is provided as a JSON string in the second element of the choices array and includes:

{
  "content": "",
  "citations": [
    {
      "id": 123,
      "source": "https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bgtKiE2v0CLtHPWUeyQjjQ1DymZI6Bho/view",
      "title": "Office Guideline",
      "last_update": 1733115000
    }
  ],
  "disclaimer": "",
  "images": [
    {
      "id": 8550,
      "source": "https://knowledge.alpha.insea.io/webapi/public/images/0dc60f2ce4580fd1443dcb8465432d0a",
      "content_type": "image/png",
      "name": "0dc60f2ce4580fd1443dcb8465432d0a"
    }
  ]
}
FieldDescription
citationsArray of citation objects referencing source documents
disclaimerOptional disclaimer text
imagesArray of image objects included in the response

Citation Object:

  • id: Knowledge ID of the knowledge document
  • title: Title of the referenced knowledge document
  • source: URL of the referenced knowledge document
  • last_update: Unix timestamp of the last updated time of knowledge

Image Object:

  • id: Unique identifier for the image
  • source: URL to access the image
  • content_type: MIME type of the image (e.g., "image/png")
  • name: Canonical name of the image
Streaming Response

When stream: true, the API returns a stream of server-sent events with the same structure:

data: {"object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1733105476,"model":"gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"You"}}]}

data: {"object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1733114110,"model":"gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":" can"}}]}

data: {"object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1733114110,"model":"gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":" play"}}]}

data: {"object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1733114110,"model":"gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":" 12:30 PM to 2:00 PM"}}]}

data: {"object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1733114110,"model":"gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":" 7:00 PM onwards"}}]}

data: {"object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1733114110,"model":"gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"Your invited guests are also required to follow these timings if they are playing games. [1]"}}]}

data: {"object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1733114110,"model":"gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"[1][Image 1]"}}]}

// Final chunk containing metadata as a second element in the choices array
data: {"object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1733114110,"model":"gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18","choices":[{"index":0,"finish_reason":"","delta":{}},{"index":1,"finish_reason":"","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"{"content":"","citations":[{"id":123,"source":"https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bgtKiE2v0CLtHPWUeyQjjQ1DymZI6Bho/view","title":"Office Guideline","last_update":1733115000}],"disclaimer":"","images":[{"id":8550,"source":"https://knowledge.alpha.insea.io/webapi/public/images/0dc60f2ce4580fd1443dcb8465432d0a","content_type":"image/png","name":"0dc60f2ce4580fd1443dcb8465432d0a"}] }"}}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":2468,"completion_tokens":51,"total_tokens":2519}}

data: [DONE]

Important: Unlike non-streaming responses where metadata is provided immediately, in streaming responses the metadata is provided only in the final chunk as a separate element in the choices array (index 1). Clients should wait for the complete stream before processing metadata.
